title: Tower 4
scene: The Menace is parked on a wide paved shoulder just before the I-5 south ramp, engine still, key in. Overcast midday. Clipboard on your thigh. The log line is I-5 south, I-90 east, valley floor only — Tower 4. CARGO is the relay kit that already fits this car: repeater set, antenna, mast clamps, lashed in the back. Nobody in the other seat. Mya is a loaf on the dash because the wheels are not turning. The mountain sits in the east as a shape, not a road. The schedule does not climb today.
debrief: Parked: cluster at zero, clipboard on your thigh, Mya on the dash. The kit sits lashed in the back for Tower 4.

source.teaching_target: Establish the Ribbon and the locked load: relay kit (repeater, antenna, mast clamps) for Tower 4, riding in the Menace. Ali alone.

image_brief.camera_pose: Chest-up inside the parked Menace, Ali centered behind the silver three-spoke wheel, enough cracked pink dash in frame that a brown mackerel loaf sits on the dashboard shelf in front of the windshield mesh — not a tight headshot that crops the dash, not a passenger-seat crop.
image_brief.subject: Ali chest-up in the parked Pink Menace, glasses, centered behind a silver three-spoke wheel, clipboard on her thigh, no second occupant; Mya a brown mackerel loaf with paws tucked on the dashboard in front of the windshield
image_brief.foreground: clipboard on Ali's thigh; silver three-spoke wheel; analog needles at rest on zero; Mya loafed on the dash top in front of the glass, not on the seat, not on the floor
image_brief.midground: cracked pink/magenta dash, pink upholstery, rocker switch bank, rebar/welded mesh across the windshield; center-dash tablet dark; still wipers; no motion in the glass
image_brief.background: wide paved shoulder, engine off, empty static overcast I-5 ramps, no motion blur, no road streaming past, no snow, no night
image_brief.read: the Menace is parked and still; Ali is alone; Mya is a loaf on the dashboard because the wheels are not turning
extra_negatives: no antenna mounted as a new roof mark
